description: An earnings call transcript with speakers, timestamps and links, one page at a time: 40 paragraphs or about 12k characters by default, whichever comes first (limit up to 150). Pass next_offset as offset for the next page; total is the paragraph count. To find one moment, search_transcripts is cheaper than paging.

offset.description: Where to start, default 0; pass next_offset from the previous page

quarter.description: Fiscal quarter key from get_company, such as 2027-q2. Omit for the latest.

ticker.description: Ticker or company name, such as NVDA, Nvidia, BCS or Barclays

name: get_transcript
title: Get transcript
